p0_finding.title: Caller-selected contract is an unrooted authority for resource, numeric, dependency, address and checkpoint semantics

mutations: psum address region overlapped with input descriptor
timestamp fields and policy replaced by caller timestamp
checkpoint identity and final-rebind policy rewritten

p0_finding.root_cause: build(repo_root, contract_path) checks only schema/selected identities and never compares contract_path against the canonical contract SHA or its double seal. Several semantic subtrees are returned verbatim and are not checked field-by-field. Thus a caller can generate a PASS-shaped preflight from the same frozen payload under a different resource and protocol contract.
p0_finding.impact: The sealed canonical receipt itself is sound, but the source/contract pair is not a fail-closed trust root for a production runner. M1106D cannot authorize runner authoring because a caller-selected contract can redefine the performance denominator and checkpoint policy without changing the PASS status.

p1_finding.title: Receipt manifest SHA was called the outer seal identity
p1_finding.impact: Terminology only in the handoff message; both identities are now pinned separately. Any future authority tuple must name them exactly.

race_observation.reason: The first read-only discovery ran before the receipt seal files were published.
race_observation.action: The hammer did not proceed until receipt.json, SHA256SUMS and SHA256SUMS.seal.sha256 appeared with all three exact identities and manifest coverage verified.

minimum_repair.source_contract_circular_identity_must_b: The successor contract must not contain the successor source SHA if the source pins the contract SHA. Bind source and contract together in an independently sealed author receipt and hammer.
semantic_field_validation_required: 96 lanes, Acc24, 3ns, 192B/cycle, 240KiB and every partition/port parameter
required dependency and timestamp fields plus absent-before-production policy
M700 exclusion and all false claim-boundary fields
minimum_repair.cli_requirement: No caller-selectable repo, contract, output or authority environment is allowed on a production-authorizing path. A read-only diagnostic CLI must use a distinct non-production status.
minimum_repair.forged_contract_regression: Repeat the combined forged-contract attack and require rejection before any M699 payload member is opened or statted.
